segs.text: Feature one: the Builder. Build a working app, just by describing it.

segs.title: Describe your app
segs.text: Start in the Builder. Describe your app in plain English, like a habit tracker with streaks.

segs.title: Review the plan
segs.text: With Plan first on, Buildify drafts a plan and asks a few quick questions before it writes any code.

segs.title: Watch it build
segs.text: Click build. The agent writes the components, runs the build and checks that it passes, while you watch every step.

segs.title: Live preview
segs.text: Then click through a live preview of your working app.
Next up: refine your app and export the code.

introSub: Build an app just by describing it
